Class ViewManagerGPS

  • java.lang.Object
    • gui.ViewManagerGPS

  • public class ViewManagerGPS
extends java.lang.Object
    Manages Leaflet map rendering for MetadataViewerDialog and delegates GPS coordinate parsing to the static methods in GpsDataManager.
